name: misterplex-pll-clock-contract
description: Shipping fabric PLL contract (pll_0002.v SoT) plus staged 720p overclock targets. Proposed targets are NOT applied until parent grants a fit.

shipping.notes: PRODUCT_V_480 forces ce_pix=1; Template H_TOTAL=638, V_TOTAL=524 → ~59.82 Hz at 20 MHz.

cdc_data_delay_class_ns.note: Measured ddr→sys meta hold paths on 8fdf440f (clk_sys_worst_setup.txt): c_line→c_line_v1 data delay 3.5–3.8 ns class; relationship 5.556 ns; slack +0.793.

A_25_90.cdc_risk: HIGH — related edge 2.22 ns < measured data-delay class ~3.5–3.8 ns; expect CDC setup HARD_FAIL unless path shortens
A_25_90.use_case: Paper cy/MB margin only; NOT preferred for 720p DE or CDC

B_30_90.cdc_risk: MODERATE — 3:1 exact; setup relationship 11.11 ns (comfortable vs 3.8 ns data) but same-edge hold family; STA hold required
B_30_90.use_case: Preferred first overclock for 720-line Template-H @60 Hz (~28.7–30.1 MHz need)

C_27_90.cdc_risk: HIGH — related edge 3.70 ns ≈ data-delay class; marginal/negative after uncertainty
C_27_90.use_case: Intermediate only if 30 MHz intra-sys Fmax fails; still CDC-risky

mandate.text: move as much into the fpga so we can do 720p

parent_decode_null_ms.note: 720p real unknown — parent measuring. Do not scale ms by pixel count.

fabric_decode_720p24.reference_cy_per_mb_source: docs/decode-throughput.md 624x480 fixture — 720p cy/MB unknown until measured
fabric_decode_720p24.verdict_30mhz: PASS paper ~1.34x if cy/MB holds; preferred with CDC

arm_ms_removed_when_offload_ships.claim: enables removal of ARM decode class 21.562–32.4 ms/frame; bump alone removes 0 ms

scale_into_template_529de.note: Works without bump but REJECTED as product end-state under ARM-evacuation mandate (keeps 480-class canvas).

native_1280_wide_de_60hz.verdict: 60 Hz 1-pix/clk WALL vs nostub Fmax 32.59. Escape: multi-pixel/clock datapath sized for 1280 from day one — not eternal M0.

ddr_bw_720p24_yuv420.note: Matches parent 33.2 MB/s; clk_ddr 90 MHz peak 720 MB/s; pessimistic 25% read budget 180 MB/s — BW OK. Coordinate w-mem. Luma line 1280 B = one M10K.
